title: woven placemats
text: woven placemats. These are ok.  The arrived rolled too tightly and I have struggled ever since I've received them to get them to flatten.  I finally turned a hair dryer on them... after about a dozen dryer sessions over several weeks, I did get them to flatten some - but not completely.  These should not be rolled - ever.  They do wipe off - but with the weave, food particles do sometimes get stuck.  I think I will go back to non-woven, smooth mat.  They are a beige - neutral.

product_metadata.title: Rimobul Crossweave Woven Vinyl Placemats, Set of 6 (Basic-Beige)
